# French words that must always carry their accents.
#
# This is the ABSOLUTE reference for scripts/check-french-accents.mjs. The twin
# comparison in that script comes up empty when apps/reference and apps/themes
# carry the same misspelling, which is how "doit etre", "n'est pas configure"
# and "l'import reel" survived in both apps at once. A word list does not care
# how many copies of the fault exist.
#
# MEMBERSHIP RULE, applied when this file was generated and to every addition:
# a word belongs here only if EVERY unaccented occurrence of it in French copy
# is a defect. That is why `marche`, `expire`, `ferme`, `grille`, `affiche` and
# `copie` are absent - each is correct French as spelled ("Comment ca marche",
# "Expire bientot", "vue grille"), and asserting otherwise would make the check
# cry wolf until somebody switched it off.
#
# Short words are where French homographs cluster (des/des, sur/sur, the/the,
# mais/mais), so words under five letters appear only when added deliberately:
# `etre`, `reel` and `lie` have no unaccented French spelling at all.
#
# Two sections, because some French words are spelled like English ones.
#
#   [any]
